I'm trying to create a mockup feature where you click on a tab and it pulls down a menu, and when you click on the tab again it goes back up. I managed to get it to work, but the Javascript only runs once. The menu goes down, then up... and then stops working. I saw some similar questions that got resolved with .addEventListener and insertAdjacentHTML , but I'm not entirely sure how to implement them, because my attempts just broke the code. function pullDown() { if (document.getElementById("dropdown").style.height == 0){ document.getElementById("dropdown").style.height = "50px"; document.getElementById("menu").style.top = "50px"; } else{ document.getElementById("dropdown").style.height = "0px"; document.getElementById("menu").style.top = "0px"; } } body{ margin:0; padding: 0; } #dropdown { height: 0; overflow-y: hidden; background-color: #04AA6D; position:fixed; transition: 1s; } #menu { background: rgb(44, 122, 190); position: absolute; top: 0; transition: 1s; }
